title: Cinematic Project Showcase / Visual Wireframes v2.0
Direction approval
composition: Hybrid luxury + experimental; near-black and ivory dominate global shell.
motion: Cinematic motion is spatial, intentional, scroll-directed, never decorative noise.
mobile: Mobile receives independent compositions, not tiny desktop screenshots.

title: Palette, type, and spacing
composition: Global base #08090B / #F8F8F5; accents appear on marble and bespoke demos.
motion: Transitions preserve typographic hierarchy; no random letter explosions.
mobile: Display scales 40-64px; body 16-18px actual CSS; control targets >=44px.

title: Site map and content priority
composition: Home establishes identity; real work demonstrates engineering; demos prove craft.
motion: 6 spatial chapters; route changes use restrained transition, never delayed navigation.
mobile: All pages direct-linked and keyboard-accessible; no mandatory intro overlay.

title: Material identity
composition: Reference screenshot is canonical. White glossy pearl with vivid cyan, magenta and violet liquid ribbons, soft aura, contact shadow and reflection.
motion: Surface shader must visually survive spin, shatter and reformation without becoming a blank point cloud.
mobile: Use a crisp optimized original asset/material; keep aura readable but not overpowering.

title: Sphere / primary motion sequence
composition: Do not replace marble with monochrome dot cloud; sphere identity is present in rest state.
motion: Cursor proximity creates full-volume shatter; moving cursor changes emission direction; on leave spring reform.
mobile: Touch drag and swipe impart force; autonomous idle, visible reduced-motion alternative.

title: Physics contract
composition: Three-dimensional particle geometry with individual rest, velocity and rotation data.
motion: Stable physics, speed clamp, continuity when pointer crosses sphere; avoid jarring infinite explosions.
mobile: Coarse pointer uses touch position/velocity; ambient motion persists without input.

title: Six-scene camera continuity
composition: 6 chapters: void → gallery → demo lights → skills lattice → paper → void.
motion: Depth, perspective, parallax and object transitions are bound to scroll progress.
mobile: No giant sticky pinned sections; reduced-motion uses crossfade/normal scroll.

title: Input equivalence
composition: Touch interactivity is not a hidden degraded replacement for desktop input.
motion: Interaction radius, energy and spring damping use normalized device-independent units.
mobile: Use touch-action scoped to hero; never block ordinary page scroll.

title: Home / filmic arrival
composition: Fullscreen dark hero; type-left, marble-right, reflective floor.
motion: Automatic direction-aware shatter; subtle autonomous hover; scroll camera pull-through.
mobile: Sphere first, clear editorial title, CTA visible; touch shatter; no scroll trapping.

title: Home / evidence-led real work
composition: One featured system as layered artifact and horizontal project index.
motion: Depth parallax transitions featured artifact into next panel.
mobile: Single editorial featured project with accessible link and four-item browse.

title: Home / cinematic demo worlds
composition: Asymmetric gallery: no repeated equal-size project cards.
motion: Hover brings stage forward; thumbnail motion must represent real functioning demo.
mobile: Four readable high-contrast demo entries; tap not hover-only.

title: Home / visible capabilities
composition: Ivory chapter, four curated strengths + lightweight dimensional technical lattice.
motion: Lattice responds to scroll and pointer subtly; no forced skills hide/toggle.
mobile: All four strengths visible, tap to evidence/complete catalogue.

title: Home / method and proof
composition: Dark method timeline with connected steps and real process evidence.
motion: Sequence reveals by scrolling; reduced-motion presents fully readable timeline.
mobile: Vertical timeline with connected labels and links.

title: Home / person and perspective
composition: Editorial ivory, human narrative with abstract spatial artwork; do not invent portrait.
motion: Camera returns to intimate paper-depth environment.
mobile: Narrative first; artwork secondary to legibility.

title: Home / inquiry + footer
composition: Large closing statement and actual validated contact workflow.
motion: Quiet final stage; reversible hover on CTA only.
mobile: Form fields remain usable; full copyright; loading/success/error visible.

title: Real Work / editorial case index
composition: Four real projects shown once, with context and evidence. Concepts segregated.
motion: Depth-led horizontal exhibit, not auto-flipping carousel.
mobile: Readable stacked case entries, clear real/concept labels.

title: GMAHK Galilea / case narrative
composition: Full case structure and screenshot gallery: challenge, architecture, outcome, tradeoffs.
motion: Artifact tilt and restrained scroll reveal; avoid fake testimonials.
mobile: Case chapter navigation, real GitHub/live links where verified.

title: Galilea Digital Archive / case narrative
composition: Archive UI artifact with authentic feature evidence and architecture.
motion: Document-layer spatial parallax, limited to hero/gallery.
mobile: Accessible diagrams, real feature text and source references.

title: Majelis Galilea / case narrative
composition: Governance workflow exhibit, outcome and constraints rather than fake metrics.
motion: Layered paper/dashboard depth, keyboard neutral.
mobile: Workflow and evidence sections remain available.

title: Naomi Rouli / case narrative
composition: Experimental typography with true project-specific assets.
motion: Editorial variable-space type and sensitive fade.
mobile: No overflow, no fabricated imagery.

title: Concept / origins / history states
composition: Explicit distinction among concept, historical prototype and real deployments.
motion: Archive-card reveal, no misleading product animation.
mobile: Honest status labels and links.

title: Demo Studio / asymmetric cinematic gallery
composition: Asymmetric exhibition with 4 flagship entries and immediate paths to all 16 functional demos.
motion: Hover/tap previews expose meaningful interaction; no self-running obstructive autoplay.
mobile: All demos visible by category browse; clear demo boundaries and safe back to portfolio.

title: Daun & Bara / working experience
composition: Dark copper / ritual editorial. Menu exploration → seating inquiry; validated date/party details.
motion: Sculpted dish depth and gentle light sweep; meal picker has visible selected state.
mobile: Design-specific mobile composition, accessible controls, complete functional workflow and no hover-only actions.

title: Lintas Teluk / working experience
composition: Sea-slate / panoramic route atlas. Destinations → itinerary selections → trip summary.
motion: Panoramic topographic parallax and guided itinerary transitions.
mobile: No scroll hijack; itinerary may collapse into vertical stepper.

title: Ruang Rawat / working experience
composition: Calm sage / rounded care product. Services → provider/time selection → contact summary.
motion: Soft spatial transition between services, staff, appointment, and summary.
mobile: Design-specific mobile composition, accessible controls, complete functional workflow and no hover-only actions.

title: NOVA Creative / working experience
composition: Electric lilac / brutalist composition. Work / services / journal / careers / inquiry navigation.

mobile: Design-specific mobile composition, accessible controls, complete functional workflow and no hover-only actions.

title: Ruang Temu Booking / working experience
composition: Warm clay / appointment as experience. Choose service/date/time; validation; shareable booking summary.

title: SERA Goods / working experience
composition: Soft lavender / boutique product gallery. Filters, variants, stock-aware cart, vouchers, delivery and checkout.

mobile: Thumb-friendly variants, cart, delivery and checkout summary.

title: Operations Decision Workbench / working experience
composition: Midnight analytical / neon mint signal. Editable scoring weights, vendor comparison, true XLSX export.
motion: Scores interpolate to exact recalculated values; evidence remains readable.
mobile: Score data become vertically stacked comparisons; exports work on supported devices.

title: Research Practice Toolkit / working experience
composition: Academic parchment / editorial research tools. 8 working tools; method/sample/assumption/citation/revision.
motion: Notebook tools unfold inline; actual calculations and exports operate.
mobile: Design-specific mobile composition, accessible controls, complete functional workflow and no hover-only actions.

title: Asset Field Companion / working experience
composition: Rugged cobalt / map and inspection. Find asset, observe, attach evidence, offline queue, sync states.
motion: Map/asset state changes and offline queue visibly persist.
mobile: Offline indicator and sync queue visible on touch; input supports camera/file permissions safely.

title: Research Data Preparation / working experience
composition: Minimal technical light / precise diff-table. Raw vs prepared, missing/duplicates/reverse scoring, exports.
motion: Row-level diff reveal and transformation previews with rollback.
mobile: Raw/prepared tables use horizontal scrolling with sticky headings.

title: Document Automation Studio / working experience
composition: Editorial paper / A4 artifact studio. Validated fields, draft preview, real PDF and activity archive.
motion: Document-page zoom/turn subtly; live A4 preview and real PDF output.
mobile: A4 preview zoom and editable form appear as stacked accessible steps.

title: SERA Operations Console / working experience
composition: Deep plum / warehouse control room. Order states, stock movement ledger, returns and daily close.
motion: Kanban/order-state moves reflect validated transitions.
mobile: Design-specific mobile composition, accessible controls, complete functional workflow and no hover-only actions.

title: Quality Evidence Room / working experience
composition: Swiss monochrome / test instrumentation. Semantic checks, responsive measurement, bounded release report.
motion: Metrics animate only from real measured data; limitations clearly labeled.
mobile: Design-specific mobile composition, accessible controls, complete functional workflow and no hover-only actions.

title: Project Brief & Scope Builder / working experience
composition: Quiet charcoal / cinematic question funnel. Service-specific scope, boundaries and copyable structured brief.
motion: Question-by-question spatial slides with durable brief preview.
mobile: Design-specific mobile composition, accessible controls, complete functional workflow and no hover-only actions.

title: Morph Presentation Studio / working experience
composition: Vermilion / theatre for morphing objects. Editable copy, three object-linked scenes, SVG still export.
motion: Shared 3D object morphology across scenes with manual timeline scrub.
mobile: Manual scene scrub survives on mobile; reduced-motion still displays scene states.

title: Identity Mark Studio / working experience
composition: Swiss typographic / vector geometry. Structure, stroke/weight/contrast, live SVG and export.
motion: SVG path updates at drag-time; export faithfully matches visible vector.
mobile: Precision sliders and SVG export use large touch targets.

title: Wedding Invitation Experience / working experience
composition: Romantic porcelain / rose editorial. Live wedding editor, event details and fictional RSVP state.
motion: Very soft editorial reveal; RSVP simulated and labeled fictional.
mobile: High-contrast readable RSVP flow and validation; avoid overlapping decorative elements.

title: KOMA Manga Reader / working experience
composition: Ink and paper / tactile spatial book. Mouse-drag / touch-swipe 3D page curl, bookmarks; NO next/prev.
motion: REAL 3D PAGE CURL follows edge drag 1:1; drag threshold commits turn, release springs back; NO prev/next.
mobile: Edge-swipe page fold with finger; single page by default, bookmark retained; no arrow controls.

title: Presence Attendance / working experience
composition: Blue chronograph / live workforce rhythm. Check-in/out validation, filters, fictional ledger, CSV.
motion: Clock and ledger update from actual mock check-in/out state.
mobile: Design-specific mobile composition, accessible controls, complete functional workflow and no hover-only actions.

title: Archive Browser / working experience
composition: Warm archival cabinet / folder architecture. Folder traversal, search, previews and simulated upload queue.
motion: Folders open as spatial shelves; accessible tree and search results.
mobile: Design-specific mobile composition, accessible controls, complete functional workflow and no hover-only actions.

motion: Deliberate contemporary art transitions; preserve navigation and working flows.
mobile: Strong standalone mobile composition and accessible navigation; direct route links.

title: Capabilities / complete technical catalogue
composition: Full searchable filtered skill system; each claim links to genuine evidence.
motion: Subtle 3D skill lattice optional; never hide skills to force discovery.
mobile: Search and filters reachable by tap and keyboard.

title: About / engineering narrative
composition: Professional biography and practice with truthful profile, no fabricated portrait.
motion: Quiet editorial spatial transition from work to biography.
mobile: Biography and contact links prioritized above decoration.

title: Contact / validated inquiry
composition: Actual functional submission/status, validated fields, privacy disclosure.
motion: Focus, validation and submission states; no fake success screen.
mobile: Keyboard-visible, screen-reader labeled and touch operable.

title: Resume / authentic PDF state
composition: Real reachable CV file; preview or honest fallback, no dead anchor.
motion: Unintrusive microinteractions only.
mobile: Download/open works on mobile, PDF available offline if advertised.

title: Studio bridge / safe legacy routing
composition: Old /studio links preserved, redirected or gracefully bridged.
motion: No disorienting template switch or entrance wait.
mobile: Clear direct destination and back navigation.

title: 404 / contextual recovery
composition: Dedicated recovery art; links to home, demos and real work.
motion: A single subtle atmospheric movement, reduced-motion support.
mobile: Helpful links always visible, no hard-to-exit 3D scene.

title: Navigation / nonblocking first visit
composition: Primary nav visible, unblocked hero; settings accessible through utility control.
motion: No surprise intro dialog. Optional scene loading does not block text or navigation.
mobile: Standard menu sheet with clear close and focus restoration.

title: Shared shell / no shared demo template
composition: Global back/reset/help/disclosure elements remain constant, but demo interior layouts remain individually art-directed.
motion: Enter/exit transitions short; never delay back action or suppress focus.
mobile: Frame chrome adapts to fixed readable controls; each demo has independently composed mobile view.

title: Loading / empty / error / success
composition: Every demo implements explicit actionable loading, empty, invalid, failure and success states.
motion: No perpetual spinners; errors do not disappear without explanation.
mobile: Visible messages and focus handling; aria-live announcements for async feedback.

title: Desktop / tablet / phone rules
composition: Three explicit compositions per screen; tablet interpolates intentionally, never broken desktop.
motion: Reduce detail budget, not interaction meaning; honour reduced motion.
mobile: Touch targets >=44px, readable type, full behavior parity, intrinsic responsive tables.

title: Reliability and inclusion matrix
composition: Cinematic scenes coexist with accessible semantic HTML and product behavior.
motion: Performance is measured on devices; fallbacks retain identity rather than blank hero.
mobile: Low-end profiles and reduced-motion are first-class test cases.

title: Manga / 4-stage 3D fold
composition: Single spatial page object with continuous folding mesh. Two-page spread desktop, adaptive page on mobile.
motion: Grip edge -> deform page with pointer -> live fold/shadow -> commit/cancel on release; never snap before threshold.
mobile: Touch edge region, finger follows fold; preserve vertical page scrolling where appropriate.

title: Manga / drag targets and bookmark
composition: Page edges are draggable; menu and bookmark are separate. No previous/next button affordance.
motion: Curved geometry, front/back side, changing light and self-shadow as page folds in 3D.
mobile: Minimum responsive edge target and accessible keyboard alternative; reversible navigation and chapter list.

title: Manga / mobile tactile reading
composition: Page-by-page mobile reading with manga ink identity, bookmark and chapter list above the book.
motion: Real time 3D mesh fold with touch sample smoothing and page-turn commit threshold.
mobile: Tap controls accessible; swipe page-edge, not gesture-only for keyboard/screen reader users.
